'''Immortal Call''' is a [[guard skill]] that consumes up to 5 [[endurance charge]]s when used to apply a buff that lessens the physical and elemental [[damage taken]] by the player  for a short duration. The duration and less physical [[damage taken]] improves with the number of endurance charges consumed.

==Skill functions and interactions==
* '''Guard''': Immortal Call shares cooldown with other [[guard skill]]s such as {{il|page=Arcane Cloak}} and {{il|Steelskin}}. However, according to gem text wording, {{il|Vaal Immortal Call}} is an exception.
* '''[[Skill Duration|Duration]]''': Modifiers to {{c|mod|Skill Duration}} will increase the duration of the skill, as will [[buff]]/[[debuff]] duration modifiers. Consuming more endurance charges with the skill will also drastically increase duration.
* '''Increased buff duration per endurance charge''': Any other buffs that are applied when casting Immortal Call will also gain increased duration per endurance charge, including support gems that grant buffs. This mainly applies to {{il|Arcane Surge Support}}.
* If immortal call is [[socket]]ed into a weapon slot, the effect will end on weapon swap.
* The {{c|mod|less physical damage taken per endurance charged removed}} skill modifier is multiplicative with the innate {{c|mod|less physical damage taken}} skill modifier.
**For example, Level 1 Immortal Call with 5 endurance charges will give you a total of 81.25% less physical damage taken, not 100%.

==Version history==
{{Version history table header}}
{{Version history table row|3.29.0|
* Fixed a bug where the 15% less Physical Damage taken per Endurance Charge removed on Immortal Call was counting minimum Endurance Charges which cannot be removed.
}}
{{Version history table row|3.23.0|
* Quality now provides 0-20% increased Cooldown Recovery Rate, instead of 0-20% increased Skill Effect Duration.
}}
{{Version history table row|3.7.0|
* No longer makes you immune to [[physical damage]] for a duration. Base duration is now 1 second at all gem levels (from 0.4 seconds). Now has an instant cast time (from 0.85 seconds). Now causes you to take 25% less [[elemental damage]] and 25% less [[physical damage]] at gem level 1, with the values growing based on the gem level, up to 34% less [[elemental damage]] and 35% less [[physical damage]] at gem level 20. Now consumes [[endurance charge]]s up to a maximum of 5, causing you to take 15% less [[physical damage]] per [[endurance charge]] consumed for the buff's duration. Increases the duration of the buff by 20% for each [[endurance charge]] consumed. Now has a 3 second cooldown, which does not recover during its effect. Shares its cooldown with other guard skills ({{il|Steelskin}} and {{il|Molten Shell}}).
* The Immortal Call enchantment which previously granted a chance to not consume endurance charges now grants increased Immortal Call duration per endurance charge consumed. This affects items that had the previous enchantment.
}}
{{Version history table row|2.0.0|
* Consuming endurance charges now grants increased duration, instead of upping the base duration. The Base Duration has been increased from 250ms to 400ms. The Cooldown has been increased from 500ms to 3 seconds. The Quality now grants 2% increased cast speed per Quality.
}}
{{Version history table row|1.0.6|
* Immortal Call, {{il|Blood Rage}}, {{il|Conversion Trap}}, {{il|Animate Weapon}} and {{il|Frost Wall}} have had their base duration increased by 25%.
}}
{{Version history table row|1.0.5|
* Physical percentage based damage reduction and Immortal Call now correctly mitigate damage from physical degeneration damage.
}}
{{Version history table row|0.9.4|
* Reduced the duration of Immortal Call granted per [[Endurance Charge]] but added a 0.2 second base duration.
}}
{{Version history table row|0.9.3h|
* Fixed a bug where Physical Damage Reflection would still hurt you when you had Immortal Call on.
}}
{{Version history table row|0.9.3g|
* Changed Immortal Call to have no up-front invulnerability time (it now requires Endurance Charges to have any effect).
* Immortal Call now only prevents Physical damage.
}}
{{Version history table row|0.9.3|
* Added new skill prototype - Immortal Call: Makes the character invulnerable for a short time. Discharges all endurance charges and increases the invulnerability duration proportional to the number of charges expended.
}}
{{Version history table end}}
